input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Candidate, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for user. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with feign api user functionality, so that I can accomplish my feign api user-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a User, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Admin, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
